title: comdirect-fetch: Depot-Performance
description: Unrealisierter Gewinn/Verlust der aktuell gehaltenen Depotpositionen (total_value vs. acquisition_value aus portfolio_snapshots) – KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 4, vereinfachte Variante. ACHTUNG: enthält NICHT realisierte Gewinne/Verluste aus bereits verkauften Positionen und NICHT externe Ein-/Auszahlungen auf das Verrechnungskonto – dafür fehlt aktuell sowohl eine Depot↔Konto-Verknüpfung im Datenmodell als auch verifizierbare echte Wertpapier-Handelsdaten. Siehe docs/konzept.md Abschnitt 9.

panels.title: Depotwert vs. Kapitaleinsatz
panels.description: Summe über alle Depots. Kapitaleinsatz = Anschaffungswert der aktuell gehaltenen Positionen (acquisition_value), keine vollständige Einzahlungshistorie.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Depotwert' AS metric, SUM(ps.total_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
UNION ALL
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Kapitaleinsatz' AS metric, SUM(ps.acquisition_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Unrealisierter Gewinn/Verlust' AS metric, SUM(ps.total_value) - SUM(ps.acquisition_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Rendite' AS metric,
       (SUM(ps.total_value) - SUM(ps.acquisition_value)) / NULLIF(SUM(ps.acquisition_value), 0) * 100 AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT SUM(total_value) - SUM(acquisition_value) AS `Gewinn_Verlust`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots)

SELECT (SUM(total_value) - SUM(acquisition_value)) / NULLIF(SUM(acquisition_value), 0) * 100 AS `Rendite`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots)
